description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

You grow a twin that’s halfway fused into your body - with their underdeveloped upper body visible where it protrudes from your flesh. Decide where you want your sibling to emerge: through your chest, your back or on your side? The twin has a personality of their own and will share opinions and try to influence decisions. Describe the Motivation, Short Term and Long Term Ambition of the twin. The twin has limited ability to fulfil their own destiny however as they only control their head and their two feeble arms. Create Characteristics for the twin ( WFRP page 33), but with -30 WS, -30 BS, -30 S, -20 T, zero Agi and -20 Fellowship. The twin does not get any Fate or Resilience points and have 0 Movement as they depend on you to move for them. You get a -10 Agility modifier due to the weird appendage you have to carry around. Hits to the body have a 20% chance of striking the twin, making any Critical Wounds into head wounds. If the twin dies it will just be a dead appendage from there on.
